4:
WITH r AS (
            SELECT sym, ts, ln(price) - lag(ln(price)) OVER (PARTITION BY sym ORDER BY ts) AS ret
            FROM trades
        )
        SELECT sym, ts,
               CASE WHEN COUNT(ret) OVER w < 2 THEN NULL ELSE STDDEV_SAMP(ret) OVER w END AS roll_std_5m
        FROM r
        WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY sym ORDER BY ts RANGE BETWEEN '5' MINUTE PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
6: SELECT t.sym, t.ts, t.price, t.size, q.bid, q.ask FROM trades t ASOF JOIN quotes q ON (sym)
7: SELECT t.sym, t.ts, t.price, t.size, q.bid, q.ask FROM trades t ASOF JOIN quotes q ON (sym) TOLERANCE 5s
